rows.name: Everyday Default
rows.blurb: Sets one temperature in the middle of the dial and leaves it. The single biggest group by a wide margin.

rows.name: Quick Sear
rows.blurb: Short, hot, mid-week. Weeknight dinner rather than a project.

rows.name: Long Burn
rows.blurb: Classic barbecue. Long cooks at low temperature with the smoke mode on more often than not.

rows.name: Saturday Ritual
rows.blurb: Cooks almost exclusively at the weekend, and not often. Low engagement, high intent.

rows.name: The Tinkerer
rows.blurb: Actively manages heat through the cook — reverse sears, multi-stage ramps, constant small adjustments.

rows.name: The Overnighter
rows.blurb: Twelve-hour-plus cooks, mostly starting Friday or Saturday night. A subset of Long Burn with real stamina.
